rag.name: CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder
rag.content:
/-- The normal ordering on creation and annihilation operators.
  Under this relation, `normalOrder a b` is false only if `a` is annihilate and `b` is create. -/
def normalOrder : CreateAnnihilate → CreateAnnihilate → Prop
  | create, _ => True
  | annihilate, annihilate => True
  | annihilate, create => False

    (φs : List ��.CrAnFieldOp) :

    FieldStatistic.exchangeSign (��.crAnStatistics φc) (��.crAnStatistics φa) *

lemma normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter : (φs : List ��.CrAnFieldOp) →
    normalOrderList φs = createFilter φs ++ annihilateFilter φs
  | [] => by simp [normalOrderList, createFilter, annihilateFilter]
  | φ :: φs => by
    by_cases hφ : �� |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create
    · rw [normalOrderList_cons_create φ hφ φs]
      dsimp only [createFilter]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos]
      swap
      simp only [hφ, decide_true]
      dsimp only [annihilateFilter, List.cons_append]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_neg]

      rw [normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter φs]
      rfl
    · dsimp only [normalOrderList, List.insertionSort]
      rw [← normalOrderList]
      have hφ' : �� |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate := by
        have hx := CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (�� |>ᶜ φ)
        simp_all
      rw [normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter φs]
      rw [orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter_annihilate φ hφ']
      rw [createFilter_cons_annihilate hφ', annihilateFilter_cons_annihilate hφ']

informal_statement:
For any two operators φc and φa, where φc corresponds to the create operation and φa corresponds to the annihilate operation, the normal order of the commutator expression [φa, φc] acting on elements a and b results in zero. In mathematical terms:

$$
\text{normalOrder} \left( a \cdot [\phi_a, \phi_c]_{\text{symm}} \cdot b \right) = 0
$$
